wires.name: spillelista
wires.blurb: A guessing game on your own Spotify playlist: listen, guess the year, flip the card.

wires.name: skill-audit
wires.blurb: Go CLI that audits Claude skills against current best practice and writes the prompt to fix them.

wires.name: acme-env
wires.blurb: Split DNS and an internal ACME CA in podman: CoreDNS, etcd, step-ca and BIND, for certificates over HTTP-01 and wildcards over DNS-01, and a CA per cluster signed by its root.

wires.name: talos-cluster
wires.blurb: Talos Kubernetes in Docker that consumes acme-env: external-dns publishes into its DNS, cert-manager gets certificates and a wildcard from its CA, and its root signs the cluster's own CA.
